text:
No to two promo codes: only one promo code can be used per order, and it can't be added after the order is placed.

Your Plus discount (10% member pricing on pots and accessories) can't be combined with a promo code on the same item. If both apply to the same pot, the better discount is applied automatically. I don't have details on whether a promo code on a different item in the same order affects your Plus pricing, so I can escalate that to a Support Lead if you'd like.
